title: Real Dream
lines: When I woke from the dream, there you were
Inside this fantasy that feels so real
Shining bright, rules meant just for the two of us
The Shamanic Resin casts its magic spell
Don't cry; today is a brand new start
Even if you stumble, just get up and dance again
This very moment... maybe it's a real dream
